arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Deep left-facing crouch with ONE hammer now low at screen-left, partially obscured by a small burst of gray/tan/yellow impact chips matching original scattered silhouette. Near/free arm still reaches diagonally lower-left; exactly two arm chains and two hands, tool grip partly occluded. Head looks left/down with one eye, torso horizontal, support leg below hips and right leg bent back. Preserve the impact particle locations as a sparse effect, no flame, smoke cloud, glow, or ground plane. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
